title: HELIX Bridge: PeopleSoft Grants → Grant

source_objects.description: Award header: BUSINESS_UNIT, AWARD_ID, AWARD_DESCR, SPONSOR_ID, PI_ID (principal investigator), TOTAL_AWARD_AMT, AWARD_STATUS, CFDA_NBR.
Award-to-project link: AWARD_ID, PROJECT_ID, PRJ_BEG_DT, PRJ_END_DT. One award may have multiple projects/tasks.
Sponsor master: SPONSOR_ID, DESCR, SPONSOR_TYPE (F=federal, S=state, P=private, I=industry).
Grant budget detail: PROJECT_ID, BUDGET_PERIOD, ACCOUNT, BUDGET_AMT, COST_TYPE (D=direct, I=indirect/F&A).
Award funding: total funded amount and funding increments. Tracks when the sponsor releases funds.
Project master: PROJECT_ID, DESCR, PROJECT_STATUS, BEGIN_DT, END_DT.
Indirect cost (F&A) rate table: RATE_TYPE (on-campus/off-campus, organized research/instruction/other), IDC_RATE, EFFDT.
Grant billing: LOC draws (Letter of Credit for federal), cost-reimbursable invoices, fixed-price milestones.
Effort certification records: EMPLID, EFFORT_PCT, CERTIFICATION_STATUS.

attribute_mappings.transformation: The sponsor's own reference number (e.g., NIH grant number).
CFDA number for federal awards. Direct map.

attribute_mappings.source: Sum of PS_GM_BUDGET_DTL.BUDGET_AMT across all periods
PS_GM_IDC_RATE.IDC_RATE (latest EFFDT for the project's rate type)
attribute_mappings.transformation: Negotiated F&A rate. E.g., 55.5% MTDC for on-campus organized research.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_GM_AWD_HDR.BILLING_TYPE or derived from billing setup

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX org code. Administering department.

attribute_mappings.source: PS_GM_AWD_PRJ.FUND_CODE or derived from sponsor type
attribute_mappings.transformation: Map to HELIX fund code. Federal → restricted_federal, state → restricted_state.

notes: PS Grants Management is the most complex FIN module for research universities. Key complexities: (1) Award → Project → Activity hierarchy (one award can fund multiple projects/tasks), (2) F&A rate varies by activity type (organized research vs instruction vs other) and location (on-campus vs off-campus), (3) effort certification is semi-annual or per-pay-period depending on institution, (4) LOC draws vs cost-reimbursable billing have different timing, (5) cost sharing must be tracked and documented. The PS_LEDGER table (actuals) + PS_LEDGER_KK (budget/encumbrances) together give the full financial picture of a grant.
